items.title: Geneiva's Arroyo Greenway Phase 1 Construction Documents
items.description: Preserves the user-supplied 22-sheet City Parks and Recreation Phase 1 construction set for Geneiva's Arroyo Greenway, covering demolition, grading, drainage, fencing, electrical work, and the paved multiuse trail.
items.provenance_status: user-supplied City construction set; project context verified through the City's announcement and StoryMap
items.processing_notes: Contributed file preserved without modification; no direct City-hosted file URL is currently recorded.

items.title: Geneiva's Arroyo Greenway Phase 2 Construction Documents (99% Review)
items.description: Preserves the user-supplied 13-sheet 99%-for-review Phase 2 set for Geneiva's Arroyo Greenway, documenting proposed irrigation, planting, native seed, trees, shrubs, mulch, and landscape details; it is not a final issued set.
items.provenance_status: user-supplied City review set; project context verified through the City's announcement and public-meeting video
items.processing_notes: Contributed review file preserved without modification and explicitly labeled as a 99%-for-review document; no direct City-hosted file URL is currently recorded.
